text_elements.text: If a malfunction (e.g. abnormal voltage) occurs in a Li-ion battery cell, the module which includes the malfunctioning cell must be replaced. When replacing a module with a new one, its voltage is required to be adjusted to the adjusting voltage calculated from the maximum cell voltage of normal cells.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Voltage adjustment under low temperature conditions may require a long time. To prevent this from occurring, it is advisable to adjust voltage under room temperature conditions [20 ° C ± 10 ° C (68 ° F ± 18 ° F)].
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Double the 'MAXIMUM CELL VOLTAGE' and use that value as the module adjustment value.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Example: 3.925 V (MAXIMUM CELL VOLTAGE) × 2 = 7.850 V (Adjustment voltage value)
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: For details on the module charge balancer operation, refer to the adjuster operation manual.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Set the new module to the module charge balancer.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure module voltage and compare it with 'adjustment voltage value' confirmed in Step1.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Module voltage is lower than adjustment voltage value>>GO TO 4.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Module voltage is higher than adjustment voltage value>>GO TO 3.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: For details on the module charge balancer operation, refer to the adjuster operation manual. Discharge the module to 5.0 V using module charge balancer.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: 4.ADJUST VOLTAGE WITH A MODULE CHARGE BALANCER
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: For details on the module charge balancer operation, refer to the adjuster operation manual.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Enter 'adjustment voltage value' into module charge balancer.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: >> After module voltage adjustment, GO TO 5.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove the module from the module charge balancer.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Using a circuit tester, check that the module voltage is within the specified range.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: After adjusting the voltage, install the module to the vehicle.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check that the difference from the 'MAXIMUM CELL VOLTAGE' confirmed in Step1 is within the specified range.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Disconnect the high voltage. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 2.CHECK LI-ION BATTERY INTERLOCK DETECTIONG CIRCUIT FOR SHORT-1
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Disconnect Li-ion battery controller (LBC) harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect interlock detecting switch (high voltage harness connector) harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the continuity between Li-ion battery controller harness connector and ground.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace Li-ion battery vehicle communication harness.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 3.CHECK LI-ION BATTERY INTERLOCK DETECTIONG CIRCUIT FOR SHORT-2
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect interlock detecting switch (service plug) harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the continuity between Li-ion battery controller harness connector and ground.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace Li-ion battery vehicle communication harness.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the continuity between terminals in the figure.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When this DTC is detected, replace Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: text
